title: QueryIntent
description: Server -> Matrix. What one layer of a turn asks a structured source for. The server owns the model call that produces this; Matrix never calls a model and holds no provider credential. Everything here is typed and bounded: Matrix validates the intent against the named contract and refuses anything it cannot serve exactly.

contract_version.description: The matrix/contract VERSION this document is written against.

kind.description: CLOSED. `structured_query` binds a QueryContract by name (v1). `semantic` binds a SemanticProvider measure/dimension request and is refused with `not_covered` until then.

request_id.description: The server's request id, echoed into Matrix's journal so one id ties an interaction row, a journal row and a source statement together.

contract.description: Required when kind = structured_query. `name@version`; a bare name resolves to the latest applied version and is recorded resolved in the evidence.

semantic.description: Required when kind = semantic. Bounded: no free-form expression ever crosses this boundary.

parameters.description: Typed parameter bindings for the contract's declared parameters. A parameter the contract does not declare is `not_covered`; a value outside a declared allowed set is `not_covered`. Values are NEVER interpolated into statement text.

authorization.description: The caller's authorization snapshot, taken by the server at turn time. Matrix uses it to select the source identity or the authorization equivalence class; it can never widen what the source's own policy allows.

uid.description: The end user the server authenticated. Recorded in the journal for attribution; it is NOT a source identity.

limits.description: Hard ceilings. Matrix takes the MINIMUM of these and the contract's own limits; it never raises a contract's ceiling because an intent asked it to.

deadline_at.description: Absolute wall-clock deadline. Matrix cancels the source statement at this instant and answers `partial_result` or `source_unavailable`. It ALSO cancels when the caller disconnects, which is not expressible here and is a handler property.

freshness.description: An optional obligation from the research profile: refuse rather than answer from data older than this.

seal.description: Whether Matrix seals the result into the server's evidence plane before returning, and under what retention. `required: true` means a sealing failure is a refusal, not a degraded answer.

typed_value.description: A value with its logical type stated. Decimals and 64-bit integers travel as STRINGS: a JSON number is an IEEE-754 double in most parsers and silently loses both.

value.description: null means SQL NULL. Scalars follow canon@1's text forms; `array` carries a JSON array of typed_value.

scale.description: Required for `decimal`: the number of fraction digits the text form carries.
